items.title: Monthly Imagination Library Early Book Delivery Cohort
items.content_html: Funding 12 months of direct-to-home high-quality print books for 20 enrolled toddlers to build home libraries from birth to age 5.

_polytab.summary: Funding 12 months of direct-to-home high-quality print books for 20 enrolled toddlers to build home libraries from birth to age 5.
_polytab.plainSummary:
What is broken: Kids in low-income homes grow up without physical books.
What will be done: Mail one book every month directly to their door.
Proof: Postmaster bulk delivery manifest.

items.title: Sensory Calming Corner & Audio-Visual Books for Title I Class
items.content_html: Supplying weighted lap pads, noise-dampening headphones, and high-interest read-along audiobooks for neurodivergent second-graders.

_polytab.summary: Supplying weighted lap pads, noise-dampening headphones, and high-interest read-along audiobooks for neurodivergent second-graders.
_polytab.plainSummary:
What is broken: Sensory overload distracts neurodivergent students.
What will be done: Provide noise-canceling headphones and audiobooks.
Proof: Classroom thank-you photos and shipping receipt.

items.title: Barrier-Free Ramps & Roll-In Shower Framing for Family Build
items.content_html: Installing non-slip concrete exterior access ramps and roll-in zero-curb bathroom framing for a wheelchair-using family member.

_polytab.summary: Installing non-slip concrete exterior access ramps and roll-in zero-curb bathroom framing for a wheelchair-using family member.
_polytab.plainSummary:
What is broken: High doorstep prevents wheelchair entry.
What will be done: Build a non-slip concrete wheelchair ramp.
Proof: City building inspector occupancy sign-off.

items.title: Hospital-Adjacent Family Suite Nights & ADA Shuttles
items.content_html: Covering zero-cost lodging and ADA-accessible ground transit for family members staying beside a critically wounded service member.

_polytab.summary: Covering zero-cost lodging and ADA-accessible ground transit for family members staying beside a critically wounded service member.
_polytab.plainSummary:
What is broken: Families face expensive hotels while kids/vets are hospitalized.
What will be done: Provide free lodging and accessible shuttles.
Proof: Facility occupancy log verified by manager.

items.title: Accessible Park Trail Tactile Placards & Curb-Free Boardwalk
items.content_html: Replacing deteriorating wooden steps with a low-grade universally accessible boardwalk and braille interpretive trail markers.

_polytab.summary: Replacing deteriorating wooden steps with a low-grade universally accessible boardwalk and braille interpretive trail markers.
_polytab.plainSummary:
What is broken: Rocky dirt trails exclude wheelchair and cane users.
What will be done: Lay a flat boardwalk with braille signs.
Proof: Park Service ranger trail sign-off report.
